task_description: Refactor the tenant/project configuration system in icav2-cli-plugins into an AWS-CLI-style two-level layout (shared [tenant <name>] sections + lightweight [profile <name>]/[default] sections). Move the user-scoped access token to the tenant section and cache it per tenant. Add 'configure set-tenant', 'configure set-profile', and 'configure export <profile>'. Deprecate (warn, keep working) 'configure set' and 'tokens export'. Update CLI help/docstrings and the adjacent wiki repo. New format only; do NOT migrate the live ~/.icav2-cli-plugins/config.
